steps.title: The big picture
steps.description: Maya opens her group chat. One request brings back messages that were saved while she was away. A separate connection stays open so the next message can appear on her phone as it arrives.

steps.title: Who can open the channel?
steps.description: Maya taps a private channel. The first check identifies her account. The next checks her membership and role in this server. She can read the conversation only if the channel allows her role.

steps.title: Show who is online
steps.description: Maya’s phone keeps a live connection open. Her online status is remembered briefly, so the green dot can fade if her phone loses signal. Her saved messages will still be there when she returns.

steps.title: Save a message before delivering it
steps.description: Maya sends “Meet at six?” Follow her message to storage, then follow the news of the save toward the people online. Waiting for the write adds a delay, but a friend who reconnects can read the same message from history.

steps.title: What happens after sending?
steps.description: Follow the saved message to the notification service. Search, moderation and usage reports can each pick up their own copy of the event in this example. A slow search index can delay when the message is searchable while the chat keeps moving.

steps.title: Attach a photo
steps.description: Maya adds a photo of the meeting spot. The app asks for permission to upload it, then transfers the photo to file storage. The chat message can carry a reference to that file, which keeps a large image out of the message history itself.

steps.title: Join a voice call
steps.description: Maya joins the voice channel. The chat connection helps her find the server for the call. Once connected, her phone exchanges live audio with that server. Saving chat messages and carrying a voice call have different timing needs.

steps.title: Catch up after losing signal
steps.description: Maya loses signal in a tunnel. When her phone reconnects, the top row shows how it fetches the messages she missed. The bottom row shows how it reopens the live connection and updates her online status.

steps.title: The complete system
steps.description: Maya taps Send on “Meet at six?” Follow the dot from her phone as the chat checks whether she can post in the channel. The message is saved in history, then it appears on her friend’s phone. Waiting for the save takes an extra moment, but an offline friend can still read the message later.
